_note: Overall avatar-confidence weights (Capture Pipeline Spec §6) — the backend's 'is this recognisably them' score. TWIN LIKENESS only, never product fit. Provisional: recalibrate once real user data shows which attribute mismatches make users reject their avatar. Stored versioned/swappable per spec. Never surfaced to the user.
_note_skin_off_swatch_de: ΔE2000 (skin) to the nearest Monk swatch beyond which the read is 'off-locus' (odd lighting / non-skin / cast) — mirrors app/monk.OFF_SWATCH_DE. An off-locus skin read forces the soft re-capture nudge even if the weighted score clears the floor, because skin is the top-weighted, memory-colour attribute. Provisional; recalibrate on real flag data.
